patch.value: Bound the committed self-host artifact below GitHub's 50 MiB per-file warning

selfhost.bundle grows with history: 14,240,151 bytes (13.58 MiB) on 2026-09-12 to 49,260,541 bytes (46.88 MiB) on 2026-10-11 at main HEAD, across 15 bundle regenerations in 30 days (+35,020,390 bytes, ~1.11 MiB/day, ~2.22 MiB per regeneration). A day earlier it was 46,172,923 bytes (44.13 MiB). Linear projection: ~453.7 MiB (475.9 MB) in one year; crosses GitHub's 100 MiB hard rejection in ~48 days and the 50 MiB warning within days. The gate contract is tip-tree byte-identity at HEAD (verifySelfHost compares the advertised tip's tree against the committed source tree), so a single-snapshot bundle satisfies it: a measured HEAD-only bundle is 7,394,951 bytes (7.05 MiB), 6.65x smaller, and a snapshot bundle's size is a function of source size, not commit count. Snapshot growth over the same window was 4,037,205 to 7,394,951 bytes (~0.107 MiB/day, projected ~46 MiB in a year, driven by source growth such as tracker history files).

Regenerated selfhost.bundle is a single-snapshot (one-commit, no-prerequisite) archive well below 50 MiB (measured 7.05 MiB at the fix commit); accept:self-host still proves byte-identity of committed source at HEAD: tip-tree comparison, isolated-store import, full ancestry walk and self-containment checks all unchanged; dependency-refresh.yml keeps working unchanged (it only runs npm run self-host:write); 100% coverage kept; regression tests fail on a behavioural revert of the bounded writer; npm run release:check and bun run release:check pass at unchanged thresholds

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Option evaluation with evidence. (a) HEAD-only snapshot bundle: the gate compares tip trees only, and a one-commit parentless archive is a complete, self-contained, importable pm-vcs repository; measured 7,394,951 bytes (7.05 MiB) at main HEAD vs 49,260,541 bytes (46.88 MiB) for the full history. (b) thin/incremental bundle against a recorded base: rejected — importBundleObjects fails closed on prerequisites the isolated verify store does not carry, and verifySelfHost walks the whole ancestry, so a thin bundle cannot pass without weakening the self-containment proof the gate advertises. (c) digest-only commit plus a release asset: rejected — the artifact would stop being restorable from the repository, dependency-refresh.yml regenerates the bundle in-repo so release assets would need new publishing machinery, and byte-identity would rest on hash comparison alone rather than on a re-imported archive. Choosing (a): bounded by construction, zero workflow changes, verify path untouched.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Revert proof: with only writeSelfHostBundle behaviourally reverted to the pre-change appending writer (new tests and snapshotIsUnchanged kept), 5 of 58 self-host tests fail: 'replaces the snapshot with a fresh parentless commit when the source tree changes' (parents not empty), 'stays bounded across repeated source changes' (11 commits carried, size grows), 'regenerates a pre-bounding history bundle even when its tip tree matches' (unbounded legacy bundle reused unchanged), 'regenerates rather than reuses a thin bundle that declares prerequisites', and 'regenerates rather than reuses a bundle whose advertised tip is not the snapshot commit'. All 58 pass with the bounded writer. Coverage for scripts/self-host.ts back to 100/100/100/100 (a first draft left one uncovered branch: the ?? [] fallback for a header that omits the prerequisites key, which parseBundle accepts; covered with a test that such a header is a valid bounded snapshot).

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Measured before/after, bytes and MiB. BEFORE (origin/main HEAD, 2026-10-11): 49,260,541 bytes = 46.88 MiB (49.26 MB decimal); a day earlier 46,172,923 bytes = 44.13 MiB. Growth over the last 30 days of main: 14,240,151 -> 49,260,541 bytes across 15 bundle regenerations = +35,020,390 bytes (33.40 MiB), ~1.11 MiB/day, ~2.22 MiB per regeneration. Linear projection of the old design to one year: ~475.3 MB (~452 MiB); crosses the 50 MiB per-file warning within ~3 days and GitHub's 100 MiB hard rejection in ~48 days (~2026-11-28). AFTER (this branch's HEAD commit): 7,433,859 bytes = 7.08 MiB (7.43 MB decimal), a 6.62x reduction. Growth per regeneration is now zero by construction (the bundle replaces its snapshot instead of accumulating); residual growth is source-driven: the equivalent snapshot bundle grew 4,037,205 -> 7,394,951 bytes over the same window (~0.106 MiB/day, ~39 MiB/yr linear, projected ~46 MiB in one year, still below the 50 MiB warning). Gates: npm run release:check pass (with HOME/GIT_CONFIG isolation for CI identity), bun run release:check pass, coverage 100/100/100/100, node --test test/self-host.test.ts 58/58 pass; accept:self-host passes at the branch HEAD against the committed 7.08 MiB bundle.
